rule_timing_3_120: Place 1 doom on the current agenda.
rule_timing_3_221: Active investigator may take an action, if able.
rule_timing_3_221_flow: If an action was taken, return to previous player window. If no action was taken, proceed to 2.2.2.
rule_timing_3_222_flow: If an investigator has not yet taken a turn this phase, return to 2.2. If each investigator has taken a turn this phase, proceed to 2.3.
rule_timing_3_330: Next investigator resolves engaged enemy attacks.
rule_timing_3_330_flow: If an investigator has not resolved enemy attacks this phase, return to previous player window. After the final investigator resolves engaged enemy attacks, proceed to next player window.
rule_timing_3_440: Each investigator draws 1 card and gains 1 resource.
rule_timing_upkeep_next: Proceed to the Mythos Phase of the next game round.
rule_timing_4_001: Determine the type of skill test. Skill test begins.
rule_timing_4_002: Commit cards from hand to skill test.
